scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.serve: npm --prefix frontend run build && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev" "node scripts/wait-for-port.cjs 4000 && npm --prefix frontend run preview"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
